BrochureContent.Content:
Horan Estates are delighted to present 64 Mornington Towers, Mornington, Co. Meath to the market — a truly impressive and generously proportioned detached dormer-style family home set on a superb site in one of the area's most mature and sought-after residential developments. Overlooking a large communal green area and offering an abundance of space both inside and out, this is a home that will appeal to families seeking a lifestyle that combines coastal living with excellent everyday convenience.

The property is beautifully presented throughout and offers exceptional living accommodation across two floors. On the ground floor, a welcoming entrance hall with solid timber staircase sets a warm tone throughout, leading to a bright and spacious living room with feature fireplace and timber flooring, a large open-plan kitchen and adjoining dining room, a ground floor bathroom, and a substantial integrated garage — a rare and practical asset that adds enormous versatility to the home. 

Upstairs, the dormer-style first floor comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a particularly generous master bedroom with built-in wardrobes, along with two bathrooms, one of which features a bath with shower screen, lit beautifully by a Velux skylight. The rear garden is a fine size, enjoying an open and private outlook, with a paved patio area and lawn — ideal for outdoor entertaining and family use.

Mornington Towers is a much-loved coastal development, ideally positioned just a short walk from the stunning Mornington Beach and the scenic banks of the River Boyne estuary. The area offers the perfect balance of seaside living and everyday practicality.

The location is second to none with all amenities close by:

Short walk to Mornington Beach and the River Boyne Estuary
Less than 2 km to Bettystown village with shops, restaurants and cafés
Less than 2 km to Laytown & Bettystown Golf and Tennis Club
Close to primary schools including Realt Na Mara BNS and GNS, Donacarney
10 min drive to Drogheda town centre with a full range of retail and amenities including Tesco, Dunnes and Aldi
Laytown Train Station nearby with regular rail service to Dublin City Centre
30 min drive to Dublin International Airport via the M1 motorway
Bus stop with frequent services to Drogheda, Bettystown and beyond

This is a truly exceptional family home in a wonderful coastal setting, and early viewing is strongly recommended.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
